title: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker and Zhalfir's wandering son who plants an acorn for Wrenn, supports the survivors and holds time still so Melira's plan can be carried out.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who saved the Multiverse by swapping New Phyrexia and Zhalfir; Teferi plants an acorn in her memory.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker who gives up Venser's spark to help restore Nissa and Ajani.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A Mirran planeswalker mourning Mirrodin who struggles to call Zhalfir home and loses Melira.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A dying Mirran with a festering chest wound who proposes a plan to cleanse Nissa and Ajani at the cost of her life.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who stays beside the comatose Nissa and is reunited with her.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf compleated by Phyrexia, comatose after the war and cleansed by Melira's plan.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker compleated by Phyrexia, comatose and then cleansed, who wakes and falls asleep again.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who brings news from other planes and helps with the cleansing.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A winged angel now serene and immortal who counsels Koth.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer who explains why Phyrexia's compleated have fallen into a deep sleep.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, a Kaladeshi who braces for death on a platform until the Phyrexians fall.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: An elf of Kaldheim who counts the minutes waiting for his brother Tyvar.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Harald's brother who emerges from the sea clinging to a serpent's head.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A dead inventor whose spark Karn spent to filter Nissa and Ajani.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader whose death rendered the oil inert.

entities.name: Kamigawa family
aliases: the boy, his mother and father
entities.description: A father, mother-turned-spirit and son reunited on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading Phyrexians who fall or fall into slumber when Norn is gone.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Mirrodin's refugees now living in Zhalfir.

entities.name: Zhalfirins
entities.description: The people of Zhalfir, who communicate through drums and welcome the Mirrans.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: A Mirran with greenish skin who asks after Melira every day.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Teferi's homeland that swapped places with New Phyrexia and now hosts the Mirran survivors.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where a family reunites after the war.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where Harald waits at sea.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where Pia faces death before the Phyrexians fall.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The Mirrans' lost home, now dead.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: The substance that unites Phyrexians and listens for Norn's orders, now inert.

entities.name: Venser's spark
entities.description: The spark carried in Karn that he uses to filter Nissa and Ajani's sparks.

events.summary: On Kamigawa, a boy returns home to his father with his mother, now a spirit of glowing characters.
events.quote: A spirit that hovers before him, holding his son's hand.

events.summary: On Kaldheim, Harald counts the minutes until his brother Tyvar bursts from the sea clinging to a serpent's head.
events.quote: On the count of three hundred thirteen, Tyvar Kell bursts from the water clinging to the serpent's engorged head.

events.summary: On Kaladesh, Pia Nalaar braces for death on a platform when the Phyrexians suddenly crumble and she thanks Chandra.
events.quote: All over Ghirapur it is the same: the Phyrexians are falling.

events.summary: The Zhalfirins celebrate with drums that Phyrexia is defeated while Teferi mourns at a grassy hill.
events.quote: Phyrexia lies broken and defeated beyond the reach of time.

events.summary: Teferi plants an acorn on a grassy hill as a tribute to Wrenn and speaks to the mound.
events.quote: He lays the acorn in the little clearing he has made, then fills it in.

events.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
events.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

events.summary: In a flashback, Saheeli explains that Phyrexia's oil likely carried Norn's signal and without her the compleated are inert and asleep.
events.quote: I think all of it was tied back to Norn.

events.summary: Kaya shares news of the other planes, including that Liliana, Vivien and Tyvar are well and that Jace and Vraska are still missing.
events.quote: Still no sign of Jace, or Vraska

events.summary: Melira proposes a plan to heal Nissa and Ajani that will cost her life and Karn's spark.
events.quote: "I think I have an idea for fixing the two of them."

events.summary: Koth seeks advice from Elspeth about Melira's plan and whether Ajani and Nissa deserve mercy.
events.quote: "It's going to kill her, doing that," Koth says.

events.summary: Elspeth tells Koth that Melira chooses her end freely and urges him to make Zhalfir home, then flies him to the ward.
events.quote: "You will try to make this place home. It will welcome you, if you let it."

events.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
events.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

events.summary: Karn pulls out Nissa's and Ajani's sparks and gives up Venser's spark to filter them while Melira cleans them.
Ajani wakes briefly and falls asleep; Melira dies, and Koth, Teferi and Karn comfort one another.
Nissa wakes and reunites with Chandra, giving the survivors hope.

relations.note: Pia trusts in her daughter to get things done
relations.quote: she can trust in her daughter to get things done
"Do you see, brother? You will never outdo this!"

relations.note: Teferi plants an acorn for his friend
relations.quote: With the acorn in hand, he thought of his friend

relations.note: Chandra stays at Nissa's side and kisses her
relations.quote: She presses her lips to Nissa's.

relations.note: Koth stays at the dying Melira's side

relations.quote: "But I will always be your friend, Koth.

relations.note: They work together to save Nissa and Ajani
relations.quote: Karn will lose almost as much as Melira in this.

relations.note: Zhalfirins host and befriend the Mirrans
relations.quote: the Zhalfirins have been nothing but kind to them
Visitors like their own wandering son, Teferi.

relations.note: Saheeli helped the group understand the sleeping compleated
relations.quote: with some help from Saheeli, during her brief visit
